info.title: TeamBook Universal API
info.description: TeamBook is a resource planning and scheduling platform for projects, teams, bookings, clients, tasks, capacity tracking, and actual logs. This wrapper targets TeamBook's public REST API and currently focuses on the provable public surface around projects, users, bookings, clients, teams, tasks, and actual logs.
